definitions: n. 发掘；挖掘（尤指考古中的系统性发掘工作）

examples.text: M) Pritchett concedes that his find deserves careful excavation and preservation.
examples.explanation: 普里切特承认他的发现值得进行细致的发掘与保护。

examples.text: “Archaeology has a terrible reputation for not publishing enough on its excavations and finds,” he says.
examples.explanation: 他说：‘考古学因未能充分发表其发掘成果和发现而声誉不佳。’

relations.reason: artifact 常是考古 excavation 的发现对象；候选词条例句也涉及“发掘与保护”“excavations and finds”，与文物出土/发现语境紧密相关。
